notes.title: [Ver.1.7.0] Update Information
notes.content:
【Feature Additions】
• Added an option to wait for "Next Question" after each question in custom quizzes
• Implemented display switching when rooms are in the middle of a quiz in custom quizzes

【Bug Fixes】
• Fixed a bug where answers were incorrectly marked wrong despite being submitted within the time limit
• Fixed a bug where "likes" were not increasing
• Fixed a bug where the number of people in a room would be incorrect when inviting through the share function
• Fixed a bug where Recovery Level was not displaying in the home menu

Thank you for your continued support of Rabihon

notes.title: 【Ver 1.0.1 】Rabbi Hoshi Update Summary
notes.content:
【Rabbi Hoshi Ver 1.0.1 Update Summary】
Bugs that were reported after the release and can be quickly addressed have been addressed.
Bugs that have a relatively large impact on the appearance have been addressed.

Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug in the Steam version that the result image of the regular quiz was corrupted.
- Fixed a bug that the home balloon was shifted significantly in some resolutions.
- Fixed a bug that the SE and BGM settings in the options function were not reflected and the game was silent.
 - Fixed a bug in the iOS version that the quiz screen is partially corrupted on iPad devices.
 - Fixed a bug that Rabbi is displayed in front of the toaster for achievements.
 - Fixed a bug in the search result list of the quiz that the list was not updated when returning to the list after bookmarking a question.
 - Fixed the problem that the correct answer rate and the percentage of correct answers are not consistent with each other.
 - Fixed SE when back button is pressed in quiz set editing
 - Fixed that the quiz set reporting function was not working properly.

Update of Official Quiz
Fixed 20 incorrect/incomprehensible questions in the official quiz.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)
